functions.name: sys.blob.length
functions.purpose: Return the exact byte count without hydrating payloads.

functions.name: sys.blob.digest
functions.purpose: Return the raw-content SHA-256 commitment, independent of layout; not a full-verification claim.

functions.name: sys.blob.read
functions.signature: fn sys.blob.read(value: Blob, offset: Int, length: Int): Blob
functions.purpose: Return bounded raw-byte slice with octet-stream/null annotation; no media decoding.

functions.name: sys.blob.verify
functions.purpose: Incrementally verify the complete content and its native dependency structure.

functions.name: sys.blob.from_bytes
functions.purpose: Construct at most 8 MiB of bytes from integers in 0..255. The fallback annotation is application/octet-stream with no suffix; explicit annotate changes metadata only.

functions.name: sys.blob.to_bytes
functions.purpose: Explicit bounded materialisation of at most 8 MiB.

functions.name: sys.blob.begin
functions.signature: fn sys.blob.begin(expected_length: Int? = null, max_bytes: Int): sys.BlobWriter
functions.purpose: Begin an owned capture with a checked total bound.

functions.name: sys.blob.append
functions.signature: fn sys.blob.append(writer: sys.BlobWriter, part: Blob): Unit
functions.purpose: Append at most 8 MiB in order; enforce the total bound before acceptance.

functions.name: sys.blob.finish
functions.purpose: Seal, verify and protect the captured value without implicitly inserting a row. The fallback annotation is application/octet-stream with no suffix; explicit annotate changes metadata only.

functions.name: sys.blob.abort
functions.purpose: Abort unfinished capture; never delete a returned value.

functions.name: sys.blob.capture_file
functions.signature: fn sys.blob.capture_file(root: Str, path: Str, max_bytes: Int): Blob
functions.purpose: Capture an authorised regular file using the shared Blob writer and protection boundary. The fallback annotation is application/octet-stream with no suffix; explicit annotate changes metadata only.

functions.name: sys.blob.resource
functions.purpose: Read a safe package-relative resource in the caller module's admitted source snapshot. The fallback annotation is application/octet-stream with no suffix; explicit annotate changes metadata only.

functions.name: sys.admin.review_commit
functions.purpose: Validate and bind the exact staged candidate without changing index, branch or user data.

functions.name: sys.admin.commit_reviewed
functions.signature: fn sys.admin.commit_reviewed(review: sys.CommitReview, message: Str, author: sys.PersonIdentity? = null): sys.CommitRef
functions.purpose: Revalidate a reviewed candidate at protected publication and commit exactly that candidate.

functions.name: sys.blob.media_type
functions.purpose: Read canonical declared MIME without payload hydration.

functions.name: sys.blob.suffix
functions.purpose: Read the canonical optional suffix hint without payload hydration.

functions.name: sys.blob.annotate
functions.signature: fn sys.blob.annotate(value: Blob, media_type: Str, suffix: Str? = null): Blob
functions.purpose: Return the same immutable bytes with MIME-1-validated canonical annotations.

functions.name: sys.blob.same_content
functions.signature: fn sys.blob.same_content(left: Blob, right: Blob): Bool
functions.purpose: Exact content-only equality under admitted-witness/collision rules; may stream bytes and fail unavailable.

changed: Blob annotated value semantics and codecs

failure_conditions.sys.blob.bounds: Negative/out-of-range offset, length or octet value.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.limit: Per-call or total capture/materialisation quota would be exceeded.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.length_mismatch: Observed bytes do not match the expected complete length.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.unavailable: A required promised object cannot be obtained under the selected policy.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.corrupt: Descriptor, tree, chunk bytes, length or content digest contradict the selected profile.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.collision: Unequal contents would otherwise receive the same content commitment.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.writer_state: An operation is invalid for an aborted or finished writer.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.source_changed: Detected change to the external input during capture.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.source_denied: The selected host source/resource is not permitted or not a regular safe input.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.reference_context: A repository reference is decoded outside an admitted repository Blob slot.
failure_conditions.sys.git.stale_review: The supplied review token or candidate state no longer matches at protected publication.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.invalid_media_type: The declaration is malformed, non-ASCII or exceeds MIME-1 bounds.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.invalid_suffix: The suffix contains prohibited characters or exceeds the pinned safe suffix bounds.
failure_conditions.sys.blob.incompatible_suffix: The suffix is not permitted by MIME-1 for the known declared type.
failure_conditions.sys.vfs.name_collision: The selected portable projection would produce duplicate or ambiguous path names.
failure_conditions.sys.vfs.invalid_document: The complete editable document fails schema-directed data decoding or row validation.
failure_conditions.sys.vfs.stale_edit: The write candidate no longer matches its captured row, schema or field baseline.
failure_conditions.sys.vfs.unsupported: The filesystem operation is outside the explicitly supported EDIT-1 contract.
failure_conditions.sys.vfs.draft_retained: An edit was not accepted and its candidate is retained in bounded recovery storage.
failure_conditions.sys.format.unsupported: The repository header selects a format for which no admitted reader/writer is available.
failure_conditions.sys.codec.unsupported_value_profile: The value profile is not accepted by the selected encoding or wire context.
